description: Write a Renovate config to disk. Runs renovate-config-validator first — refuses to write if validation fails unless force=true (which additionally requires confirmForce).

confirmForce.description: Must be set to the literal 'YES_OVERRIDE_VALIDATION' when force is true. The unusual literal exists to make accidental overrides harder under prompt-injected tool calls.

filename.description: Target filename relative to repoPath (default renovate.json)

force.description: Write even if validation fails. Requires confirmForce.

repoPath.description: Absolute path to the repository root

name: write_config
title: Write Renovate config
